name: Faint Tone
source:
Yuuya was just your typical guy living a very ordinary life. However, that all changed one day with his parent’s sudden announcement that they’ll be living apart. Faced with his first life choice, should he follow his father or his mother? Should he remain in the city and continuing living this normal life, or head to the countryside and maybe find the girl that he often appeared in his dreams? After giving it some thought, he decided to lead lives in both places. Meeting the girls who were waiting for him in each place, he slowly began to remember the faint memories from his childhood, including that most precious person from his past.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
裕也只是个过着平凡生活的普通青年。然而有一天，父母突然宣布要分居，一切就此改变。第一次面临人生抉择的他，应该跟随父亲还是母亲？是留在城市，继续这份平淡日常；还是前往乡下，或许能在那里找到那个频频出现在梦中的女孩？经过一番思考，他决定同时过上两地往返的生活。与分别在两处等待他的少女们相遇后，他渐渐找回模糊的童年记忆，其中也包括过去那个对他而言最珍贵的人。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
